QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Member of The Maple Alliance
QuestInfo.0: Get Penni's help to travel to Ereve, the sky island.
QuestInfo.1:
You met Empress Cygnus, who told you about the #rBlack Mage#k and the Maple Alliance built to fight against him.

Her sincere eyes and determined voice entreat you to join her cause.
QuestInfo.2:
Penni took you to Ereve, the island in the sky.

You met Empress Cygnus there.
She earnestly asked you to support the Maple Alliance.

You told her you'd join willingly.
She presented you with a medal and a new skill as proof of your membership.
